titulo: EU leaders ‘light-years away’ on agreeing budget at summit, warns Giorgia Meloni – Europe live
cuerpo: A number of leaders hope to agree to a budget before consequential elections around the continent The Danish prime minister, Mette Frederiksen, has acknowledged that leaders remain “very far apart,” agreeing with Germany’s Merz that the current proposal is not going to work. “The budget is too large and not sufficiently future-oriented,” she said, calling for more work on competitiveness, defence and security.
